name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, closed]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Checkout the event commit in both jobs. A PR merge ref can disappear while
# queued runs start, and a base branch can advance after the merge event.
jobs:
  backend:
    name: Backend vet, build, and test
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' || github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      GOWORK: 'off'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@924ae3a1cded613372ab5595356fb5720e22ba16 # v6.5.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            relaykit/go.sum
            tokenkit/go.sum

      - name: Create frontend embed placeholder
        run: |
          mkdir -p web/dist
          touch web/dist/index.html

      - name: Vet root module
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Vet relaykit independently
        working-directory: relaykit
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Vet tokenkit independently
        working-directory: tokenkit
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Build root module
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Build relaykit independently
        working-directory: relaykit
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Build tokenkit independently
        working-directory: tokenkit
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Test root, relaykit, and tokenkit modules
        run: make test

  frontend:
    name: Frontend typecheck and test
    if: github.event.action != 'closed' || github.event.pull_request.merged == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: web

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: '1.4.4'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Typecheck
        run: bun check -b

      - name: Test
        run: bun run test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
